analysis.title: Cross-Asset Correl Flips // Mid-Terms Pricing // Buy-the-Dip Flows // China Rebound // Gold
key_insights: Rates drove a significant flip in cross-asset correlations in October, and average correlation levels are now at multi-year lows.
Cross-asset implied correlation has not yet responded to the flip in realized correlation. UBS S&T sees this as an opportunity for risk-off hybrid hedges.
Mid-term volatility premiums are rebounding into the event. UBS S&T still sees optionality through the rest of the week as good value.
Leveraged-fund investors have been buying the dip, including on Friday, although rebalance flows involved much larger selling.
Rebecca Cheong also notes buy-the-dip activity in RMM and Excess Flow on Friday, and options investors continue to fade moves.
Offshore China equities rebounded, supported by rotation into defensives. Low FXI implied vols offer tactical upside.

Gold rebounded strongly on Monday and sank again on Tuesday, continuing a strong negative correlation with the USD. Skew is bid for puts, and spot is near where hedge funds suggested interest. UBS S&T sees growing value in bull collars.
